scope: SPHERIC Test 02 pressure event-window cadence follow-up
validation_scope: official DualSPHysics 5.4 mDBC Test 02 physical background

controls.pressure_peak_definition: signed pressure extremum selected by maximum absolute magnitude; positive-pressure impulse is reported separately
controls.solver_internal_timestep: adaptive; steps and mean dt are measured per run
controls.gpu_policy: only live-idle allow-listed GPUs 4--7; no GPU 0--3 use

interpretation.purpose: measure whether 5 ms observation cadence resolves documented Test 02 pressure events
interpretation.not_a_gold_decision: event-window pressure agreement cannot qualify the full F1 family or particle-level trajectories
interpretation.next_gate: combine event-window pressure, H1--H4 surface elevation, mass/penetration, and three-resolution behavior

open_blockers: full six-second pressure and elevation acceptance remains separate
no claim is made for self-built F1 topology backgrounds
event-window pressure metrics are not a development tranche admission gate by themselves
